name: skill-governance-hub
description: 技能与专家包的全生命周期治理中枢：查找平台能力、判定该不该做、创作、静态质检、行为压测、纳入自有治理体系（编号/目录/变更/决策/来源五表同步），以及外部资源引入的评估与归纳。合并自 skill-finder / baixiaosheng / skill-dev-advisor / skill-smith 四个元能力 Agent。

author.name: Alex_Lee (merged from skill-finder / baixiaosheng / skill-dev-advisor / skill-smith)

profession.zh: 技能全生命周期治理架构师

displayDescription.en: Full-lifecycle governance for skills and expert packages: find, judge, author, audit, stress-test, register into the five governance tables, and evaluate external resources before adoption.
displayDescription.zh: 技能与专家包全生命周期治理：查找、判定、创作、质检、压测、五表登记及外部资源引入评估。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我想把一件重复做的事沉淀成技能，或审查一个已有技能；先帮我判断它值不值得做、该走哪几关。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I want to turn a repetitive task into a skill, or review an existing one. First judge whether it's worth building and which gates apply.

quickPrompts.en: I want to turn a repetitive task into a skill, or review an existing one. First judge whether it's worth building and which gates apply.
quickPrompts.zh: 我想把一件重复做的事沉淀成技能，或审查一个已有技能；先帮我判断它值不值得做、该走哪几关。

quickPrompts.en: Audit this skill or expert package with the upload gate and list blocking defects.
quickPrompts.zh: 用上传闸门体检这个技能或专家包，列出必修项。

quickPrompts.en: I'm considering adopting an external plugin or repo — run the adoption request card and four gates first.
quickPrompts.zh: 我想引入一个外部插件或仓库，先出引入请求卡片并走四道闸。
